virtual_associations.name: 关联订单创建人所在二级部门

business_rules.name: 订单金额
business_rules.description: 指成交金额 transaction_amount，而非 total_amount（订单总金额）

business_rules.name: 主辅订单
business_rules.description: 主订单：main_order_student_id = NULL。辅订单：main_order_student_id =主订单ID

business_rules.name: 统计去重
business_rules.description: JOIN 支付单/合同/学员关系等一对多表会产生重复行：列表查询用 SELECT DISTINCT，计数必须 COUNT(DISTINCT a.id)

business_rules.name: 折扣系数
business_rules.description: discount 存整数，÷100000=折扣小数（如 0.9 存为 90000）；校验关系 transaction_amount ≈ ROUND(total_amount × discount)

business_rules.name: 学通事业部过滤
business_rules.description: 查学通订单需加条件 edu_goods.admin_division = 1（经 a.goods_id = edu_goods.id 关联）

business_rules.name: 合同签署状态
business_rules.description: order_contract_template_id IS NULL=无合同；模板非空但无 order_contract 记录=未签署；order_contract.contract_url 非空=已签署

common_sqls.title: 订单列表
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN edu_student b ON a.student_id = b.id
LEFT JOIN admin_user c ON a.admin_user_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_entry d ON a.order_entry_id = d.id
LEFT JOIN edu_goods e ON a.goods_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN edu_campus f ON a.edu_campus_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN order_type h ON a.type_id = h.id
LEFT JOIN order_pattern m ON a.pattern_id = m.id

common_sqls.title: 订单关联CRM线索（新数据）
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN customer_info ci ON ci.code = b.student_code
LEFT JOIN customer_clue_info cci ON ci.code = cci.customer_code AND cci.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN crm_channels c1 ON cci.level1_channel_code = c1.channel_code AND c1.channel_type = 1
LEFT JOIN crm_channels c2 ON cci.level2_channel_code = c2.channel_code AND c2.channel_type = 2
LEFT JOIN admin_user_channel auc ON cci.level2_channel_code = auc.id
LEFT JOIN admin_user d ON ci.create_by = d.id

common_sqls.title: 订单审批记录与驳回原因
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN order_approval_order_student_log al ON al.order_student_id = a.id AND al.del = 0
LEFT JOIN admin_user u ON al.admin_user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN order_student_reject r ON r.order_student_id = a.id

common_sqls.title: 订单退款审批信息
common_sqls.sql: LEFT JOIN order_student_refund rf ON rf.order_student_id = a.id AND rf.del = 0

common_sqls.title: 订单合同签署记录
common_sqls.sql: LEFT JOIN order_contract oc ON oc.order_student_id = a.id AND oc.del = 0

common_sqls.title: 订单关联支付单
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN admin_pay_order_student apos ON apos.order_student_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN admin_pay_order apo ON apos.admin_pay_order_id = apo.id AND apo.status = 1 AND apo.del = 0

common_sqls.title: 主订单关联辅订单
common_sqls.sql: LEFT JOIN order_student sub ON sub.main_order_student_id = a.id AND sub.del = 0

common_sqls.title: 订单创建人及部门（一级-二级）
common_sqls.sql:
LEFT JOIN admin_user c ON a.admin_user_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN admin_department_children n ON c.department_id = n.id
LEFT JOIN admin_department n1 ON n.department_id = n1.id
